title: Pi 4B integrated power, Sharp display and swappable GPIO baseboard

currentCapacity.rationale: 3A Type-C advertisement only; 820 ohm TPS259531 ILM limits downstream to about 2.63A high corner before resistor tolerance. 0.75mm is conservative versus ~0.67mm IPC-2221 estimate for 2.7A/2oz/10C. Validate port-pin aggregation and actual copper.

USB_VBUS.rationale: Local power copper must reach 0.4mm-pitch BQ25622/TUSB320 lands: 0.25mm clearance erases the neck; use the existing 0.15mm manufacturing floor. Current, nominal width, minimum width and escape length are unchanged.

currentCapacity.rationale: Post-TPS259531 input limited around 2.63A high corner before resistor tolerance; 0.75mm conservative versus ~0.67mm IPC-2221 for 2.7A/2oz/10C. Validate fault current and temperature.

CHG_VBUS.rationale: Local power copper must reach 0.4mm-pitch BQ25622/TUSB320 lands: 0.25mm clearance erases the neck; use the existing 0.15mm manufacturing floor. Current, nominal width, minimum width and escape length are unchanged.

BAT_RAW.rationale: Size copper trunk above 6A/2oz/10C estimate; package escape remains a local limitation. Local power copper must reach 0.4mm-pitch BQ25622/TUSB320 lands: 0.25mm clearance erases the neck; use the existing 0.15mm manufacturing floor. Current, nominal width, minimum width and escape length are unchanged.

escape.rationale: BQ25622 RYK pad 8 is fine pitch; only the sub-1mm land escape may narrow to 0.2mm before a 2mm battery trunk. This is not a 6A trace rating.

currentCapacity.rationale: BQ25622 battery-path ceiling is 6A continuous; ~1.78mm external 2oz/10C estimate. This is a copper target, not a verified package or pack rating.

SYS_RAW.rationale: Size copper trunk above 6A/2oz/10C estimate; package escape remains a local limitation. Local power copper must reach 0.4mm-pitch BQ25622/TUSB320 lands: 0.25mm clearance erases the neck; use the existing 0.15mm manufacturing floor. Current, nominal width, minimum width and escape length are unchanged.

escape.rationale: BQ25622 RYK pad 9 permits only a short fine-pitch land escape; bulk SYS must be 2mm or copper plane.

currentCapacity.rationale: SYS may carry almost the BQ25622 6A battery-path limit; ~1.78mm external 2oz/10C estimate. Actual package escape, vias, copper and thermal qualification remain required.

escape.rationale: Short RYK pad 16 escape only; switch-loop trunk and inductor landing must remain wide.

currentCapacity.rationale: BQ25622 switch current limit is 3.5A class. Short, local SW-to-inductor copper still needs package-specific loop review and thermal validation.

CHG_SW.rationale: Local power copper must reach 0.4mm-pitch BQ25622/TUSB320 lands: 0.25mm clearance erases the neck; use the existing 0.15mm manufacturing floor. Current, nominal width, minimum width and escape length are unchanged.

CHG_PMID.rationale: BQ25622 supplier land is0.2240026mm; routed KiCad copper is quantized to0.224mm. Declare that existing geometric minimum explicitly instead of a sub-micron false width failure. Nominal width is unchanged; this does not rate high-current trunks. BOOST_SW.rationale: Peak switch current approaches 8A; keep the inductor-switch loop short with wide copper.

currentCapacity.calculationMethod: IPC-2221 external trace estimate for approximate RMS
currentCapacity.rationale: Switch path carries >5.8A approximate input current at full load plus ripple; 6A/2oz/10C estimates ~1.78mm. This does not replace switching-loss/thermal validation.
5.1V source target 3.3A, including Pi, LCD and margin; 0.8mm above ~0.78mm 2oz/10C estimate. Confirm regulator and load-switch thermal loss.
Switched 5.1V trunk carries 3.3A target before Pi/LCD branches; verify voltage drop and transients.

LCD_ILM.rationale: TPS259470 RPW adjacent land edges are only 0.200mm apart; 0.15mm is the declared fabrication clearance floor and permits the local escape. Trace-width and current limits are unchanged.

currentCapacity.rationale: I=0.048*(10C)^0.44*A^0.725 gives about 81 mil^2; at nominal 2oz (2.756 mil) this is 0.747mm. Use 1.2mm nominal and validate actual copper, vias, losses and temperature.

V5_LCD.rationale: TPS259470 RPW adjacent land edges are only 0.200mm apart; 0.15mm is the declared fabrication clearance floor and permits the local escape. Trace-width and current limits are unchanged.

footprintExceptions.rationale: Supplier land has a pad10 rectangle and overlapping pad10/VOUT3 polygon. Both are one physical VOUT terminal, joined also to VOUT pins8/9 per TI DML pin map. Preserve same logical port/net; do not treat polygon as an unconnected second net.

copperAreas.name: BOOST_SW_JOIN
copperAreas.rationale: Join TPS61088 SW4..7 to the adjacent inductor pad on the same outer layer; keep switch copper local and verify the 6A loop in the filled board.

copperAreas.name: BOOST_INPUT_LOCAL
copperAreas.rationale: Input capacitor and HF bypass feed TPS61088 VIN and the inductor input; widen the VIN branch into a 2mm-class input area outside its fine land.

copperAreas.name: CHARGER_BAT_FANOUT
copperAreas.rationale: BQ25622 BAT pad 8 fans out below the package into the adjacent battery capacitor and 2mm-class landing. Preserve the <=1mm narrow escape requirement; inspect the filled neck.

copperAreas.name: CHARGER_SYS_FANOUT
copperAreas.rationale: Separate SYS from BAT immediately outside BQ25622; local 2mm-wide outer copper links SYS to the inductor output and the two nearby system capacitors, around the package rather than across BAT.

copperAreas.name: CHARGER_VBUS_FANOUT
copperAreas.rationale: BQ25622 input pin 18 local outward fanout for the protected USB supply. Keep separate from PMID and SW; bulk CHG_VBUS remains 1.2mm.

copperAreas.name: CHARGER_PMID_LOCAL
copperAreas.rationale: Local PMID HF capacitor connection at BQ25622 pad 17, with bulk capacitor connected by routing; no false split net.

copperAreas.name: MAIN_SWITCH_OUTPUT
copperAreas.rationale: TPS22990 VOUT1/2/3 aggregate into a 1.45mm-wide output landing, clearing grounded PG/GND pins and the VIN thermal pad.

copperAreas.name: PI_FUSE_INPUT
copperAreas.rationale: TPS259470 IN and EN aggregate above the package; keep the opposite OUT and side OVLO controls separate. Main trunk remains 1.2mm.

copperAreas.name: LCD_FUSE_INPUT
copperAreas.rationale: TPS259470 IN and EN aggregate above the package; keep the opposite OUT and side OVLO controls separate. Main trunk remains 1.2mm.

copperAreas.name: PI_FUSE_OUTPUT
copperAreas.rationale: TPS259470 Pi OUT pad fans out above the package to a >=1.2mm output landing, outside the side ILM control land.

copperAreas.name: AUX_LIMIT_INPUT
copperAreas.rationale: TPS2553 input branch local wide landing; auxiliary 100mA load stays on the protected main rail.

copperAreas.name: USB_VBUS_CONTACTS_1
copperAreas.rationale: Aggregate the paired Type-C VBUS contacts with a widened landing inside the board, while preserving shell and adjacent signal clearance.

copperAreas.name: USB_VBUS_CONTACTS_2
copperAreas.rationale: Aggregate the paired Type-C VBUS contacts with a widened landing inside the board, while preserving shell and adjacent signal clearance.

copperAreas.name: CC_VDD_LAND
copperAreas.rationale: TUSB320 VDD short outward branch landing; this low-current supply branch must not set the width of the 2.7A USB trunk.

copperAreas.name: CC_OR_VDD_LAND
copperAreas.rationale: Local VDD landing at current-advertisement logic; branch carries logic supply current only.

copperAreas.name: USB_EFUSE_INPUT
copperAreas.rationale: Aggregate both TPS259531 IN terminals onto solid local copper before the 1.2mm USB trunk.

copperAreas.name: USB_EFUSE_OUTPUT
copperAreas.rationale: TPS259531 OUT local widened copper to the protected charger input trunk, clear of FLT above it.

copperAreas.name: AON_LDO_INPUT
copperAreas.rationale: Join TLV75533 IN and EN with local SYS copper; branch is low current and the SYS trunk keeps its 2mm target. Unified with the overlapping same-net capacitor landing; physical copper is their geometric union.

copperAreas.name: CHARGER_SW_LOCAL
copperAreas.rationale: BQ25622 SW pad 16 to inductor switch terminal and bootstrap capacitor; narrow package neck only, then at least 1.2mm local switch-node copper. Inspect fill at PMID and VBUS neighbours. Unified with the overlapping same-net capacitor landing; physical copper is their geometric union.

copperAreas.name: BOOST_5V_DISTRIBUTION
copperAreas.rationale: Continuous outer 2oz output copper joins TPS61088 OUT pins, the rotated capacitor bank, feedback upper resistor, TPS22990 decoupler and VIN exposed pad. Main distribution corridor is 2mm wide; inspect routed cuts and local pin necks. No trace or current requirements changed.
